build_quanto_quantizer: build a QuantoQuantizer instance for diffusers models with optimum-quanto backend
validate_quanto_environment: validate the environment for quanto quantization including package availability and version checks
create_quantized_param: create a quantized parameter by freezing a module weight tensor on a target device
adjust_max_memory: adjust max memory dictionary by reducing each device's memory allocation to 90 percent
update_torch_dtype: update the torch dtype for quantized model loading defaulting to float32 when not specified
